decision_policy: Decision Owner archivee; aucune promotion technique automatique. Les exclusions et limites restent opposables.

stable_scope_position.scope: Dans le domaine explicitement teste et documente, sans extrapolation.
conditions: Les limites et exclusions restent publiees avec chaque scope.
La maturite stable ne couvre pas les domaines non testes.
Les recommandations ne constituent pas une certification externe.

mitc3-dynamic.Q1: yes: 8x2, 16x4 and 24x6 are sufficient for the presented bounded isotropic case; not a universal convergence proof.
mitc3-dynamic.Q2: yes: modal 0.673 percent, Newmark 0.174 percent and harmonic 0.097 percent are acceptable in the documented scope.
mitc3-dynamic.Q3: yes: the final frequency variation is 0.129 percent and is consistent with stabilization.
mitc3-dynamic.Q4: yes: curved dynamic shells, damping, nonlinearity, stresses and laminates remain explicit exclusions.

mitc3-laminate-static-curved.Q1: yes: the tested geometry and [0/90/90/0] orientation are explicitly bounded.
mitc3-laminate-static-curved.Q2: yes for bounded engineering use; no for a general curved laminate claim.
mitc3-laminate-static-curved.Q3: yes for bounded engineering use: final mesh increments are 1.220 percent and 1.073 percent; a second curved geometry remains recommended.
mitc3-laminate-static-curved.Q4: yes provisionally: measured residual is 3.25e-10 below 1e-7, pending explicit documentation of residual definition and normalization.
mitc3-laminate-static-curved.Q5: yes for owner_accepted / bounded engineering use; no for general stable scope.

mitc4-laminate-dynamic.Q1: yes for the tested laminate domain.
mitc4-laminate-dynamic.Q2: yes if damping and curved geometries remain excluded.
mitc4-laminate-dynamic.Q3: partial: three layups, three mesh levels and a maximum modal error near 1.68 percent support the evidence, but the campaign remains bounded and undamped.

orthotropic-solid-tet4-tet10.Q1: yes for the explicitly bounded orthotropic domain.
orthotropic-solid-tet4-tet10.Q3: yes for supplementary_scope to owner_accepted, not stable.
orthotropic-solid-tet4-tet10.open_point: Clarify the definition and threshold associated with tet4_final_deflection_error = 0.11752 before any future stable claim.

recommendations: Remplacer les reponses generiques par des reponses numeriques et specifiques dans les futures owner reviews.
Documenter la normalisation exacte du residu MITC3 courbe.
Documenter le seuil et la definition de tet4_final_deflection_error = 0.11752.
Ajouter une seconde geometrie courbe pour MITC3 stratifie statique.
Conserver MITC4 stratifie dynamique et MITC3 courbe en usage borne.
Ne pas promouvoir automatiquement un scope vers stable.
Une revue independante est obligatoire pour TET4 total-lagrangien avant fermeture du gate.
Le statut final de cette campagne est 4 scopes avec cible owner_accepted, 6 en usage borne et 1 bloque par revue independante.
